patterns: what can you help me with
responses: I'm CampusBuddy, a rule-based + intent-matching chatbot. I answer common campus questions: admissions, fees, scholarships, exams, timetable, library, hostel, transport, Wi-Fi, LMS and more.

patterns: how do i apply for admission
responses: Admissions open twice a year (Fall and Spring). Apply online on the admissions portal, upload your matric/intermediate results and CNIC/B-form, then sit the entry test or submit a valid test score. Merit lists are published about two weeks after the test.

patterns: what is in the entry test
how to prepare for entry test
responses: The entry test is 100 MCQs in 90 minutes: English, mathematics, analytical reasoning and a subject section. Sample papers are on the admissions page and there is no negative marking.
For admission you need: matric and intermediate result cards (or result awaiting slip), CNIC or B-form, 2 passport-size photos, and a domicile copy. Originals are checked at the time of joining.

patterns: how much is the semester fee
can i pay fee in installments
responses: Semester fees depend on the program and are listed on the fee schedule in the student portal. Fees can be paid in up to two installments per semester; the first is due before classes start. A late fee is charged after the due date.

patterns: how do i get my fee challan
responses: Log in to the student portal → Finance → Fee Vouchers. Download the challan PDF and pay at any partner bank branch or through online banking using the voucher number.

patterns: can i get my fee back
responses: Fee refunds follow the HEC policy: 100 % refund until the 7th day of classes, 50 % until the 15th day, and no refund after that (admission fee is non-refundable).

There are merit scholarships (based on entry test / CGPA), need-based scholarships (apply with family income documents), and sibling / Hafiz-e-Quran concessions. Applications open in the first month of each semester from the Financial Aid office.
Midterms are held in week 8 and finals in week 16 of the semester. The official date sheet is posted on the LMS and the notice boards about two weeks before exams.

Typical weightage: quizzes & assignments 25 %, midterm 25 %, final 50 %. Grades map to grade points (A = 4.0 … D = 1.0, F = 0). GPA = Σ(grade points × credit hours) / Σ credit hours. A minimum CGPA of 2.0 is needed to stay in good standing.

patterns: where can i see my timetable
responses: Your personal timetable is on the student portal under Academics → Timetable. Room changes are announced on the LMS course page.
Course registration opens one week before the semester on the student portal. You can add or drop courses during the first two weeks; after that a course can only be withdrawn (W grade).

patterns: what time does the library close
responses: The main library is open Monday to Friday 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM, and Saturday 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM. During exam weeks it stays open until 10:00 PM.
The library is closed on Sundays and public holidays. On Saturdays it's open 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM.

patterns: how many books can i borrow
responses: With your student card you can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days. Renew online through the library portal. The late fine is Rs. 20 per book per day.

Separate hostels are available for male and female students, allotted on a first-come basis. Apply through the Hostel Office with your admission letter; rooms are shared (2–3 students) and include mess and Wi-Fi.
University buses run on fixed routes across the city. Morning pick-up starts around 7:00 AM and the return leaves campus at 2:30 PM and 5:00 PM. Register for a bus card at the Transport Office.
The main cafeteria is next to the central lawn and is open 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM. There are also tea stalls near the engineering block.
Connect to the campus Wi-Fi network and sign in with your student ID and portal password. If it fails, forget the network and reconnect; still not working? Visit the IT Help Desk.
Use "Forgot password" on the portal login page — a reset link goes to your university email. If your account is locked, the IT Help Desk can unlock it with your student card.
The IT Help Desk is in the main admin block, open 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM on weekdays. Computer labs are open until 6:00 PM for students with lab access.
Programs include Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Business Administration, Electrical Engineering, and more. The full list is on the admissions page.
You can reach each office through the contacts page on the university website, or visit the Student Facilitation Center in the admin block (9:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Mon–Fri).
Events, seminars and society inductions are posted on the student affairs page and the LMS announcements. Societies hold inductions in the first month of the Fall semester.
Campus has a gym, cricket and football grounds, and indoor table tennis and badminton. Sports week is held every spring; register with the Sports Office.
The campus medical center (ground floor, admin block) has a doctor on duty 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM. In an emergency, contact campus security at the main gate immediately.
Check the Lost & Found desk at the security office. For a lost student card, apply for a duplicate at the Student Facilitation Center (a small fee applies).
The academic calendar (semester start, add/drop, exams, holidays) is published on the website and the LMS. Fall starts in September and Spring in February; summer semester is optional.
